page.notes: Printed in three columns, all entries transcribed as lines. Several entries were hard to read at this scan resolution: "Inuenta ao retinenda" (the word after "Inuenta" is unclear, possibly "ac"), "Iuddicis fufpecti recufatio" (the first word may be misprinted), "Iuftitia noftra vnde petenda 129. b." (the "b." may be a separate reference), and "Iudicium fletere quid" (the verb could be misread). Entries "Infermetati panes in fefto pafcha tis cur comefti" and "Iudici quæ maxime timeantur" appear as printed with possible line-break gaps. Several entries carry the references "ibid." and "dem" from broken lines (e.g. "ibi-dem", "ibi dem"). Column 1 line "Imp.ll.de ijs qui errores sparse runt" has a doubtful word at the line end.
